import collections

string under_thousand(int number)
    small := [
        "zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten",
        "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen", "fifteen", "sixteen", "seventeen", "eighteen",
        "nineteen",
    ]
    tens := ["", "", "twenty", "thirty", "forty", "fifty", "sixty", "seventy", "eighty", "ninety"]
    string[] parts := []
    if number >= 100
        .parts.push(small[number / 100] + " hundred")
    remainder := number % 100
    if remainder >= 20
        part := tens[remainder / 10]
        if remainder % 10 != 0
            part += "-" + small[remainder % 10]
        .parts.push(part)
    elif remainder > 0
        .parts.push(small[remainder])
    return parts.join(" ")

numbers := [0, 13, 40, 100, 568, 71000, 300019, 999999]
for number := numbers[]
    string[] parts := []
    if number == 0
        .parts.push("zero")
    if number >= 1000
        .parts.push(under_thousand(number / 1000) + " thousand")
    if number % 1000 > 0
        .parts.push(under_thousand(number % 1000))
    words := parts.join(" ")
    println("{number}: {words}")
